name: Willy-Food Investments Ltd
summary: Willy-Food Investments Ltd engages in the developing, importing, marketing, and distributing a range of food products in Israel and internationally. It offers rice, pasta, sauces, oils, crackers, dried fruits, snacks and nuts, jams, cereals, and doughs. The company also provides sweet and savoury pastries, dairy products, various cheeses, and butter, as well as canned products, such as fruits, vegetables, and fish. It offers its products under Complete, Daawat, Dona Roza, El Pastor, Euro, Gold Food, Golden, ItalPizza, Kolios, Manat Hachef, Muratbey, Pasta Italiana, Pinukim, Sera, Valio, willifood, Wyke, and Zanetti brand names.
